mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in FEDFUNDS above 2.5% over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary regime, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.10) during periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5% for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in UNRATE below 4.0% for two consecutive months indicates weakening labor market conditions, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings, which in turn drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative during periods of two consecutive months with UNRATE < 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly decline in GDPC1 signals deteriorating aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and compresses equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative following two consecutive quarterly declines in GDPC1.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent monthly decline in INDPRO and RSAFS signals contraction in industrial production and retail sales, indicating weakening economic activity and lower earnings, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO and RSAFS both decline month-over-month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both INDPRO and RSAFS decline month-over-month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp monthly drop in HOUST below 1500 thousand units, coinciding with a decline in GDPC1, signals a housing market contraction that amplifies recession risk and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when HOUST < 1500 and GDPC1 declines in the same quarter.

mechanism_narrative: A rapid increase in CPIAUCSL above 3% month-over-month, combined with a flat FEDFUNDS, signals unmet inflation expectations and impending policy tightening, which predicts negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when CPIAUCSL > 3% month-over-month and FEDFUNDS is unchanged.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly rise in PAYEMS above 0.5% coinciding with a rise in UNRATE above 4.0% signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 0.5% and UNRATE > 4.0% in the same month
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS > 0.5% and UNRATE > 4.0% in the same month.

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly rebound in GDPC1 above the previous quarter, with INDPRO also rising, signals improving demand and production conditions, predicting positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and INDPRO both rise quarter-over-quarter
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise quarter-over-quarter.
